name: skills

scripts.conformance: npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --contract skill.list --args '{}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --contract skill.read --args '{"name":"nonexistent"}'

description: CAK 插件：技能库（skill.list@1 / skill.read@1）— 技能=给模型看的流程说明书（SKILL.md），三处来源，读取进账本
